sources.title: Sentiment Analysis using NLTK - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Sentiment Analysis using NLTK involves analyzing text data to determine whether the expressed opinion is positive, negative or neutral. NLTK provides essential tools for text preprocessing, tokenization, and sentiment scoring, making it a popular choice for basic NLP sentiment classification tasks.
